subject: general
question: Name the minister who resigned during the India China war in 1962?
solution:
The correct answer is **V. K. Krishna Menon**.

__
 
• **The minister who resigned during the India-China war in 1962 is V. K. Krishna Menon.**__​

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vengali Krishna Kurup Krishna Menon was an Indian politician,non-career diplomat, and nationalist.
 
• He was born on 3 May 1896, Kozhikode.
 
• He wrote the first draft of Preamble to the Constitution of India.
 
• He coined the name Non-Alignment movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Sino-India war between India and china occurred in October-November 1962.
 
• A disputed Himalayan border was the main cause of the war.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
